At my age, I have been growing beans on this small plot for many years, and I know they do well enough with the soil we have without spending money on expensive fertilizer. My grandchildren help me when they are not in school, so we can manage the weeding and harvesting as a family without needing to hire ganyu labor. I save my seed from last season because it works well here, and beans do not suffer from the pests that bother our maize, so there is no need for chemicals on this plot.
